ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_softplus_advantage_square_normalized
ir.intuition: Normalize the weighted softplus loss by the sum of weights to ensure scale-invariance and stable gradients regardless of batch weighting, while preserving the square advantage weighting for signal emphasis.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_sq = advantage_gap ^ 2
score_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
loss_raw = softplus(-score_diff) * adv_sq * weight
normalized_loss = sum(loss_raw) / (sum(weight) + epsilon)
return normalized_loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    adv_sq = ops.mul(adv_gap, adv_gap)
    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    loss_raw = ops.mul(ops.softplus(ops.neg(score_diff)), adv_sq)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_raw, weight)
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)
    epsilon = 1e-8
    normalized_loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), ops.add(weight_sum, epsilon))
    return normalized_loss
